दत्तक (पुत्र) m. a son given away (to be adopted by
others).
दत्तदृष्टि a. turning the eye upon, looking at (loc.).

दत्तवर a. allowed to choose a boon or granted as a
boon.
दत्तशुल्का f. having been bought with money (a bride).
दत्तातङ्क a. making fear, frightening (gen.).
दत्ति f. gift, donation, offering.
†दाति f. gift, liberality.
दत्तोत्तर a. passing a judgment.
दत्त्रिम a. received by gift (son or slave).

द॑त्र n. wealth, pl. goods;
 p. ˚वन्त्.
1 दात्र॑ n. distribution, share, possession.
2 दा॑त्र n. sickle, scythe.
दत्व॑न्त् a. having teeth, biting.
दा॑तवे dat. inf. to 1 दा.
दा॑तवै॑ dat. inf. to 1 दा.

दा॑तिवार a. giving freely, liberal (lit. choosing or
liking to give).
दा॑तु n. share, allotted portion.
2 दा॑तृ m. cutter, mower, reaper.
दातृप्रतीच्छक m. du. giver and receiver.
दात्यूह m. ई f. a kind of cock or hen.
दात्यौह॑ m. = prec. m.
